steps.en: Officer selects notices from the search or upload results
steps.id: Petugas memilih notice dari hasil pencarian atau upload

steps.en: Officer chooses the Apply PS operation and presses Select
steps.id: Petugas memilih operasi Apply PS lalu menekan Select

steps.en: Eligibility of the selected notices is checked before the PS form opens
steps.id: Kelayakan notice terpilih diperiksa sebelum form penangguhan dibuka
steps.why_en: Only the processing stage is checked, and one failure blocks the whole selection.
steps.why_id: Hanya tahap proses yang diperiksa, dan satu kegagalan memblokir seluruh pilihan.

steps.en: Officer fills the PS reason code and remarks and confirms
steps.id: Petugas mengisi kode alasan PS dan catatan lalu mengonfirmasi

steps.en: One request applies permanent suspension to all selected notices
steps.id: Satu permintaan menerapkan penangguhan permanen ke semua notice terpilih

steps.en: Permanent suspension is recorded on each notice
steps.id: Penangguhan permanen tercatat pada tiap notice

steps.en: The bulk result shows how many succeeded and which failed, with reasons
steps.id: Hasil bulk menampilkan jumlah berhasil dan yang gagal beserta alasannya
steps.why_en: A timeout on a large batch still shows a success message with zero notices.
steps.why_id: Timeout pada batch besar tetap menampilkan pesan sukses dengan nol notice.
